newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Beijing Datang Power shelves flotation plan - paper.
newsitem.headline: Beijing Datang Power shelves flotation plan - paper.

text.p: China's Beijing Datang Power Generation Co has shelved plans for a dual share listing in Hong Kong and London which was expected to raise up to US$300 million, the South China Morning Post said on Monday.

The newspaper said global co-ordinator Salomon Brothers told underwriters last Friday that "despite the recent strength in the equity markets generally, the H-share market continues to be weak as the end of the year approaches".
"As a result, Beijing Datang and its global co-ordinator continue to monitor the market to determine the most suitable time for the initial public offering," it was quoted as saying.
Officials at Salomon Brothers were not immediately available for comment.
Beijing Datang originally planned to start its international road show on Monday and its underwriters had been premarketing the issue during the past three weeks, the daily said.
